messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 3.4.1

3.4.1. Uncontrolled movements Machinery or related products shall be designed, constructed, and where appropriate placed on a mobile support, in such a way as to ensure that, when moved, uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity do not affect its stability or exert excessive strain on its structure.

response.text:
Machinery or related products | shouldAvoidStabilityLoss | uncontrolled oscillations of centre of gravity affecting stability | when moved | "Machinery or related products shall be designed, constructed, and where appropriate placed on a mobile support, in such a way as to ensure that, when moved, uncontrolled oscillations of its centre of gravity do not affect its stability"
Machinery or related products | shouldAvoidExcessiveStrain | uncontrolled oscillations of centre of gravity exerting excessive strain on structure | when moved | "or exert excessive strain on its structure"
Machinery or related products | mayBePlacedOn | mobile support | where appropriate | "where appropriate placed on a mobile support"
